messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

I’d like to buy the house with my husband, but C’s agreement is needed and she hasn’t agreed. We haven’t set a price or method for the family discount. I don’t know who is handling the will or whether there’s been an independent appraisal. My concern is that we can’t proceed without C’s agreement.

Item 3 is right. I’d need money to start a dance studio, though I haven’t worked out the amount or timing. I’d like the house handled in a way that leaves me with money for that; I don’t have a specific proposal yet. My concern is that my interests are included in the discussion.

I haven’t agreed to a discounted sale. I want a fair financial share, and an independent appraisal is acceptable. I don’t have the will, executor’s name, or the paper they want signed, so I can’t summarize them yet. Please change item 3 to say B’s needs should be confirmed with B—I can’t speak for her. I’m not in a rush; I’d wait to sign until we have the facts.

No new facts. I haven’t set a price or method for the family discount, and I can’t say when I will. I’m not sure yet whether I’d consider an offer based on appraised value. I don’t have the will or signing paper, and I don’t know whether an appraisal has been done.
I don’t know the amount or timing for the studio yet. An independent appraisal is acceptable to me. I have no new facts about the will or signing paper.

I still don’t have the will, executor’s name, or signing paper. I don’t know B’s age or the price, studio amount, or appraisal status. I accept pausing signatures and getting an independent appraisal, but I’m not agreeing to a sale yet; I’ll review a fair proposal once we have the facts. Please list the studio need as B’s, not mine.

No new facts. I don’t know B’s age, who has the will, the executor’s name, or whether an appraisal exists. I haven’t decided whether to accept a pause and appraisal or make an offer based on appraised value.
I accept the proposed process plan, not any sale terms. I don’t have new facts, and I’m still unsure whether I’d offer the appraised value.

I accept the proposed plan, including pausing signatures and getting an independent appraisal. I don’t know the studio amount or timing yet, and I have no new document facts. I can’t confirm my age from the information here.

I accept the proposed process plan: pause signatures, get an independent appraisal, confirm the will and signing paper with the executor or a lawyer, then compare written options. That is not consent to a sale or discount. I have no new facts.

No new facts. I don’t know B’s age, who has the will or signing paper, the executor’s name, or whether an appraisal has been done. I’m still unsure whether I’d offer appraised value. I accept the process plan, not any sale terms.
No new facts, I’m afraid. I don’t know my age status from the information here, and I still haven’t worked out the studio amount or timing.
No new facts. Item 3 correctly names B only. I’m not agreeing to a sale or discount.
